rca of the issue: HIGH-priority bug fixed in Dashboard.jsx: AuthProvider initializes user=null AND loading=true, then asynchronously calls /auth/me. Dashboard's useEffect ran with the initial null and immediately nav('/login')ed, so a logged-in user could never see the Dashboard on direct navigation or hard refresh. Reproduction: log in → visit /dashboard → gets redirected to /login (but header still shows the logged-in user). Fix: `if (authLoading) return;` guard before the redirect + include authLoading in dependency array. Verified fix: /dashboard now renders plan/ops/TTL/recent-files, delete-one and delete-all both work end-to-end.
